title: Book Two · Chapter 26: One Apple for the Girl
story:
On Friday, Ronan wants to take the first turn again.

He sits down and reaches for the card. Jun keeps one hand beside it.

“I want to start today,” Jun says. “You can listen.”

Ronan lets go. “All right.”

Jun tells the story from the little notes. He stops once at the end of the second box. He looks at the page, then goes on.

Ronan waits. Jun reaches the last line and finishes.

“That was slower than yesterday,” Ronan says.

“I checked the order.”

“You can say it faster.”

“Can you tell me the order now?”

Ronan tells him. The woman lends the bowl. The girl takes it home. Soup and lunch come next. Then the girl returns the bowl.

Jun nods. He gives Ronan the card.

Ronan tells the whole story. This time he does not stop after his own half. He reaches the apple at the end.

“The girl takes one apple home,” he says.

Miss Wu comes over with a pile of exercise books. She hears the end and asks a question.

“Does the girl bring three apples home?”

“No. One,” Ronan answers.

“Where are the other two?”

Ronan points at the woman in the picture.

“They stay with her.”

“Yes. And later? Does the woman eat them later?”

He looks again. The page says three apples go in the bowl. The woman gives one to the girl. It does not say more about the other two.

“The page does not tell us,” he says. “Only one goes home with the girl.”

Miss Wu nods. “That part is clear.”

She takes the exercise books to the next row. Another child needs help with a number. Their table must work alone now.

Ronan looks at Jun. “Was my answer wrong?”

“Two are in the bowl after that,” Jun says. “The woman may eat one later.”

Ronan smiles. “Or both.”

“Not in our story.”

They turn to the card. The little strip is dry. Jun can lift it at one edge, but he presses it down again.

“Leave that,” Ronan says. “It will tear.”

Jun takes his hand away. He puts the card between the two copies.

They take one more turn each. Ronan asks a question about the first part. Jun answers with the page open. Jun asks about the last part. Ronan finds the right line and reads it.

Across the room, Leo and his partner are practising too. They use quiet voices. Mei reads a line, then puts a short note beside her own page.

Ronan looks at their table. He cannot hear every word. He turns back to Jun.

At the end, they put the shared card in the classroom tray. Each boy takes his own story copy home for the weekend.

“Do not lose it,” Jun says.

“You too.”

“I will put it in my book.”

Ronan folds his sheet along the old fold. The word after is still clear above it.

Outside, Leo asks about the apples. Ronan gives the short version of the story.

“I want that bowl,” Leo says.

“For soup?”

“For apples.”

“You still need to wash it.”

Leo makes a face. They leave school together, and Jun walks with them as far as the first corner.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- whole＝整个的
- version＝版本、讲述
- tear＝撕裂、裂开
- tray＝托盘

## 理解问题

1. 关于另两颗苹果，正文明确说了什么、没有说什么？
2. 两人这次怎样检验对方是否理解了全部故事？

## 从认词到读句子

正文原句：*Only one goes home with the girl.*

**Only one / goes home / with the girl.**

只有一颗苹果／回家／跟着那个女孩。one在这里代指一颗苹果。
